raised: Page gives no amounts, fees, returns or time periods, so nothing can be compared (low confidence on what to do)
Small gray line about the per-product investment row is barely noticeable
Tops and titles of the 'כסף שוטף וקצר' cards are cut off, so the reader had to guess what they were
'קרן חדשה כללית' is confusing: the 'maximum amount' is never explained
'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' is confusing: why is severance in a savings fund?
Top of the 'לבחירה עצמית' section is cut off; it seems aimed at experts
מק"מ, government bonds and the general track were not understood (why would I want מק"מ?)
The 'בשפה פשוטה' line only rewords the title and doesn't help
Grey 'יומית' / 'מתחדשת' buttons on the קרן כספית card are unclear
MSCI World vs MSCI AC World difference is only visible by reading the number of countries
Terms like אג"ח, קרן נאמנות and 'קרן שעוקבת אחריו' are not understood
Dollar exposure vs hedged (S&P 500) is not understood at all
Pension terms קצבה, תגמולים and פיצויים are not understood
Unclear who the מנהל תיקים and בית השקעות are
'תקרה שנתית' has no amount
'תקופה שקבע החוק' has no length (how many years the קרן השתלמות locks money)
Unclear whether paying tax on profit at withdrawal is better or worse than buying the S&P 500 directly
No guidance on how much to put where, or in what order
Fees, risk and returns are missing
No comparison of the S&P 500 inside a קופת גמל vs buying through a broker
No guidance on how to check what you already have through work
Would cut the Tel Aviv indexes (ת"א-35/90/125)
Would cut 'לילדים'
Would cut 'מה האתר עוד לא מכסה'
Would cut Nasdaq 100 and MSCI AC World
